headline: New law lets federal maternal and child health grant money be used to help prevent stillbirths.
what_it_does: This law expands the Maternal and Child Health Services Block Grant, a federal grant program for mothers, babies, and children. It adds research and activities to prevent stillbirths to the list of things the grant can pay for. A stillbirth is when a baby dies in the womb late in pregnancy.

who_it_affects.how: They may benefit from new stillbirth prevention efforts paid for through the grant program.

who_it_affects.group: State maternal and child health programs
who_it_affects.how: They can now use block grant funds for research and activities aimed at preventing stillbirths.
Their work on preventing stillbirths may now be supported by this grant program.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted July 12, 2024; the summary does not give a separate start date.
